title: Plumbs Limited
summary:
[manufacturer] Plumbs Limited — a family-run soft-furnishings company founded in 1953 and headquartered at Brookhouse Mill, Old Lancaster Lane, Preston, Lancashire PR1 7PZ, UK, trading nationwide through www.plumbs.co.uk with made-to-measure sofa covers, curtains, blinds and reupholstery delivered via a free in-home consultation model. The company entered administration on 15 October 2024 (Joint Administrators Sarah O’Toole and Jane Steer, PwC); the majority of the business and assets — including 239 employees — were sold to Sarah Plumb Limited, and the administration concluded on 14 October 2025. The exfiltrated backups are dated June–September 2026.

The captured dataset is the company’s complete file-server and database estate: six shares (E, G, O, P, SQLFilesSage, Shares-Misc) totalling ≈205 GB across 697,364 filesystem entries.

<redacted>

Customer data. O/LIVEDB2 (70 GB, plus an 11 GB duplicate) is the complete RMAN backup set of the production Oracle order/customer database, current to 29 September 2026. G/CallCentre/Extracts contains 873 CSV extracts (2002–2026) whose verified schema is Customer Name, Address, Tel1, Tel2, Mobile, Email Address, Cust No. Shares-Misc/Paragon/Data holds DAILY PLANNING route files for 2017–2026 (customer delivery addresses and slots). Order-level sales with postcodes were verified in G/Finance/Fabric Usage Mar2025.csv (12.6 MB).

Employee and contractor data. G/HR (14 GB) contains Personnel Files including a 768 MB leaver archive, CV’S (164 MB), HR-2025 Updated (3.2 GB), Occupational Health, salaries, P60/P11d, disciplinary toolkits, gender-pay-gap files, and Carl Oracle Info.xlsx — a verified workforce register of Oracle user IDs, initials, full names, departments and payroll numbers. G/Payroll (1.1 GB) holds 2023–2026 payroll reports, Attachment of Earnings, and Driving Licence Checks. P/DSE Assessments contains 118 per-employee health assessment files bearing individual names. G/TDManagement holds current and terminated self-employed Technical Designer records including VAT status and personal purchases.

Financial data. G/Finance (38 GB) includes Bank Statements both (1.7 GB), BACS service forms, a verified BACS payment-run file with payee bank identifiers, supplier payment forecasts with HSBC balances, Customer Accounts Refunds (6 GB of weekly scanned refund packs 2023–2026), Management Accounts (15 GB), budgets 2020–2026, CBILS loan records, credit checks, and the fixed asset register. SQLFilesSage contains the MSSQL 2019 Sage instance directory (system databases and trace logs only; the old PlumbsYe2021.mdf was probed and found to be an empty shell).

Engineering IP. E/Ora_Apps (1.1 GB) is the full source of the Oracle Forms 11g order-processing application (87 MB of converted form XMLs, PLLs, dbforms); G/CAD (14 GB) plus CADUser01–06 profiles and Scratch/CMF Models Finished (195 MB) hold Lectra CAD cutting patterns; Lectra entitlement certificates (GBR-OS1230458/9) and CAD support bundles were verified in Scratch/IT.

Legal and administrative material. G/HR/HMRC holds a multi-year HMRC enquiry file (HMRC 6.5–6.15, information requests and draft responses); G/HR/1. Sarah Plumb Ltd (144 MB) and G/Directors hold administration and sale records; G/Finance/Legal completes the privileged set.
